content_policy: English Aviation questions include English answer plus full Chinese explanation.
Chinese Aviation questions contain Chinese answer only.
Quick cards are shortened to roughly one-minute review.
Course/type-specific techniques are labeled as heuristics or type-specific rather than universal SOP.
accuracy_normalizations: Standard-rate turn defined by turn rate, not fixed 30-degree bank.
Three-degree glidepath VSI uses GS×5 as a rough rule; exact geometry is about GS×5.3.
Operational FAA ILS glide-slope paired channels are 329.15–335.00 MHz; wider 328.6–335.4 MHz wording is treated as an engineering spectrum band.
Straight-and-level trim is described as relieving sustained control pressure, not trimming a VSI value.
VREF+5–10 and 20/80 visual scan are labeled training heuristics, not universal SOP.
